description: This file defines the main React component for the App interface of a persona-building web application. It manages state, handles file uploads, orchestrates backend processes for persona generation, displays progress, and provides user interface elements for editing and viewing persona details. The code includes hooks for data fetching, state management, and user interactions, along with detailed UI layout and styling.

classes.name: Experience
classes.description: Defines the experience object used in PersonaData for professional experiences.

classes.name: PersonaData
classes.description: Represents the structure of persona information including skills, experiences, and other profile details.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a string array if possible, filtering invalid entries.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Maps backend JSON data into the UI PersonaData structure, with fallback defaults.

methods.name: handleFileChange
methods.description: Handles file input change events, validates files, and adds them to upload list.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Validates and appends new files to the uploaded files list while enforcing limits.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a file from the uploaded files list by ID.

methods.name: handleGenerateDraft
methods.description: Initiates backend process to generate a persona draft from uploaded documents and starts polling for status.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Saves the current persona data as a new version to the backend.

methods.name: refreshVersions
methods.description: Loads the version history from the backend for a given persona ID.

methods.name: handleProfileImageChange
methods.description: Handles updates to the profile image, creating object URLs for display.

methods.name: removeExperience
methods.description: Removes a professional experience entry by ID.

methods.name: addSkill
methods.description: Adds a new skill to the persona.
